learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be distinguished from security-related inconclusive findings. An API error should not trigger escalation audits for disagreement resolution.
The audit tool should implement retry logic or fallback handling for transient API errors before marking a file as inconclusive.

When a package has only 2 files (.SRCINFO and PKGBUILD) and one model fails on .SRCINFO but succeeds on PKGBUILD, the tool should recognize that .SRCINFO is derived metadata and its failure should not override a successful PKGBUILD audit.
